title: EventEnvelope
description: Device -> hub event. Published on MQTT topic hub/{device_id}/event/{type} or POSTed to /events/{device_id}. The topic/URL device_id and type MUST equal the envelope's.

schema_version.description: Envelope major version. Breaking changes bump this (see protocol/CHANGELOG.md).

id.description: Optional unique event id (UUID) so the hub can drop QoS-1 duplicates.

device_id.description: Lowercase slug; also the MQTT username.

ts.description: Event time, ISO-8601 in UTC with a literal Z suffix.

type.description: Dotted lowercase event type, e.g. phone.notification, voice.wake.

payload.description: Type-specific body. Per-type payload schemas will be added as types stabilize.
